items.title_en: How Europe is killing makers and micro-entrepreneurs
items.title_zh: 欧洲如何扼杀创客与微型创业者
items.summary_en: Regulatory complexity and licensing requirements raise the cost of doing business for makers and micro-entrepreneurs, chilling innovation. Cross-border compliance and VAT burdens amplify the risk for small operations. The piece calls for reforms to simplify rules and support lightweight cross-border activity.
items.summary_zh: 监管复杂性与许可要求提高了创客与微型创业者的进入成本，压制创新。跨境合规与增值税负担放大了小规模运营的风险。文章呼吁简化规则、降低成本以支持轻量级的跨境经营。

items.title_en: iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses will remain on icloud.com
items.title_zh: iCloud+ 的隐藏我的邮箱地址仍将保留在 iCloud.com
items.summary_en: Apple confirms that Hide My Email addresses will remain hosted on iCloud.com, not moved elsewhere. The arrangement preserves privacy by keeping masked addresses within Apple’s ecosystem, making it easier to manage identities without exposing real emails. Developers relying on Sign In with Apple can continue to interact with the anonymized addresses in a privacy-preserving way.
items.summary_zh: 苹果确认 Hide My Email 的地址仍然托管在 iCloud.com，而不会迁移到其他域名。此举维持隐私机制，让用户在不暴露真实邮箱的前提下继续使用掩码地址，并在苹果生态系统中进行身份管理。对于使用 Apple 登录的开发者来说，相关的匿名地址仍可用，隐私保护功能得以持续。

items.title_en: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
items.title_zh: 小米新 CPU 单线程媲美苹果核心，多线程更快
items.summary_en: Xiaomi claims its new CPU matches Apple cores in single-thread performance while delivering dramatically higher multithreaded throughput. If credible, this signals a notable architectural advance that challenges Apple on core design rather than just clock speed. It hints at new efficiency and scheduling strategies that could shift smartphone performance benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 小米声称新CPU在单线程性能上可与苹果核心媲美，但在多线程吞吐方面提升显著。如果属实，意味着在核心设计层面对苹果形成挑战，或引入新的高效性与调度策略，可能改变智能手机性能基准。

items.title_en: Oceans hit highest temperature on record
items.title_zh: 海洋温度创历史新高
items.summary_en: Global oceans continue warming, reaching an all-time high temperatures that intensify coral bleaching, disrupt marine ecosystems, and feed back into climate extremes. The trend underscores the urgency of reducing greenhouse gas emissions and improving climate resilience in policy and industry.
items.summary_zh: 全球海洋温度再创新高，威胁珊瑚和海洋生态系统，并可能加剧极端气候事件。这一趋势凸显减排与提升海洋与气候韧性的紧迫性。

items.title_en: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.title_zh: MS Paint 与 Photos 本地输出也会隐形嵌入 GUID 水印
items.summary_en: A watermarking scheme in MS Paint and Photos adds invisible GUID watermarks to outputs, even when images are created locally. That enables provenance tracking without visible marks, raising privacy concerns for casual image creation. It underscores how embedding traceability in software can alter what users consider private.
items.summary_zh: MS Paint 与 Photos 的输出会隐形嵌入 GUID 水印，即使在本地生成的图片也如此。这为溯源提供了隐形标记，引发对普通用户隐私的担忧，并凸显软件层面嵌入可追踪性的风险。

items.title_en: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.title_zh: 将整个旧金山市变成一款电子游戏
items.summary_en: A project renders the entire city of San Francisco as an interactive video game map, turning streets and districts into playable pixels. It illustrates how geospatial data and game-like interfaces can transform urban exploration and planning. The work also raises questions about scale, realism, and simulation ethics.
items.summary_zh: 一个项目把旧金山市转化为可互动的游戏地图，将街道与区域变成可玩的像素。它展示了地理空间数据与类游戏界面对城市探索与规划的潜在变革，同时引发对规模、真实感与仿真伦理的思考。

items.title_en: Coding expertise is going to collapse from AI reliance
items.title_zh: 依赖 AI 将削弱编码专业能力
items.summary_en: An argument that heavy reliance on AI for coding could erode developer expertise over time, as automation handles more of the craft. The piece warns about skill decay and emphasizes maintaining hands-on practice and understanding of fundamentals. It calls for safeguards to preserve deep coding competence.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为对编码的高度 AI 依赖可能随着时间削弱开发者的专业能力，因为自动化接管了更多技术工作。警示技能退化并强调保持实际编码实践与对基础原理的理解，呼吁采取措施维护深层的编码能力。

items.title_en: Thomson Reuters Launches Its Own Frontier Model
items.title_zh: 汤森路透推出自有 Frontier 模型
items.summary_en: Thomson Reuters launches its own frontier model, leveraging its vast data assets to build an enterprise-grade AI model. The move signals how large data-driven providers are racing to offer trusted, specialized AI around journalism, finance, and information services.
items.summary_zh: 汤森路透推出自有 Frontier 模型，利用其庞大数据资产打造面向企业的 AI。此举显示大型数据驱动提供商正在竞相提供可信、专业化的新闻、金融与信息服务 AI。

items.title_en: How Universities Should Prepare Founders
items.title_zh: 高校应如何培养创始人
items.summary_en: Paul Graham argues that universities should do more than fund startups; they should build founder-friendly programs, incubators, and practical pathways for turning student ideas into companies. The piece emphasizes mentorship, access to resources, and closer ties between academics and industry. For readers, it reframes higher education as a potential pipeline for scalable tech startups.
items.summary_zh: 保罗·格雷厄姆认为高校不应只资助创业，而应建立面向创始人的课程、孵化器和将点子转化为公司的实际通道。文章强调导师资源、获取资源的机会，以及学术与产业的紧密衔接。对技术读者而言，这一观点将高校视为可催生可扩展科技创业的潜在渠道。

items.title_en: Everything I own, owned
items.title_zh: 我所拥有的一切，终究被拥有
items.summary_en: Explores what it means to own things in a world where ownership can be distributed and intangible.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在一个所有权可以分散且无形的世界里，拥有到底意味着什么。

items.title_en: Moon (2024)
items.title_zh: Moon（2024）
items.summary_en: Moon (2024) is a recent project released in 2024 that centers on the Moon.
items.summary_zh: Moon（2024）是一个在2024年发布的近期项目，聚焦于月球。

items.title_en: IPFS Maintainers Winding Down
items.title_zh: IPFS 维护者退出维护
items.summary_en: IPFS maintainers are winding down their involvement, signaling potential shifts in governance and sustainability for the decentralized file system. The move could affect long-term maintenance and the vitality of the IPFS ecosystem if community support wanes.
items.summary_zh: IPFS 的维护者正在逐步退出，可能影响去中心化存储系统的治理与可持续性。如果社区支持减弱，长期维护与生态活力将面临挑战。

items.title_en: One corner of China’s internet is insisting that the Tang Dynasty never existed
items.title_zh: 中国互联网的一个角落坚持唐朝从未存在
items.summary_en: A fringe faction in China’s online world is propagating the claim that the Tang Dynasty never existed, a provocative example of how memes and misinformation spread in modern social networks. The phenomenon underscores how historical narratives can be engineered online and the challenges platforms face in policing or contextualizing fringe theories.
items.summary_zh: 中国互联网的一个边缘群体在传播“唐朝并不存在”的说法，揭示现代社交网络中历史类迷因的扩散机理。此现象凸显网络环境对历史叙事的塑造力，以及平台在对待此类极端观点时的挑战。

items.title_en: OpenAI: GPT 5.6 Sol price reduction (until at least Nov 21)
items.title_zh: OpenAI：GPT‑5.6 Sol 定价下调（至少至11月21日）
items.summary_en: OpenAI cuts prices for GPT-5.6 Sol, at least through November 21, lowering the cost of API usage. The discount may accelerate adoption by startups and developers experimenting with AI services. It also signals competitive dynamics in API pricing.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 GPT-5.6 Sol 的价格下调，至少在11月21日之前有效，降低了 API 使用成本。这一降价可能推动初创公司和开发者更积极地尝试 AI 服务，同时体现 API 定价的竞争态势。

items.title_en: Andreessen Horowitz is investing billions into a bleak future
items.title_zh: A16z在黯淡未来中投出数十亿美元
items.summary_en: Andreessen Horowitz is deploying billions into bets on a purportedly bleak future, backing AI, crypto, and frontier tech across its portfolio. The piece analyzes why a16z-funded bets persist despite macro headwinds, and what it implies for startups, competition, and policy shaping.
items.summary_zh: A16z正向其投资组合投放数十亿美元，覆盖AI、加密等前沿领域，押注一个被描绘为艰难的未来。文章分析在宏观环境不确定的情况下为何仍持续进行此类长期赌注，以及这对初创公司、竞争格局与政策走向意味着什么。

items.title_en: Was modern art a CIA psy-op? (2020)
items.title_zh: 现代艺术曾是 CIA 心理战吗？（2020）
items.summary_en: The piece revisits whether modern art programs were covertly shaped by CIA support during the Cold War, highlighting how cultural funding and strategic messaging intersected with geopolitics. It underscores the lasting questions about art, influence campaigns, and the tech of information warfare.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾冷战时期现代艺术是否在秘密资助下受到 CIA 的影响，揭示文化资助与战略传播如何与地缘政治交织。揭示了关于艺术、影响力行动与信息战技术之间的持续讨论。

items.title_en: Where did all the public bathrooms go?
items.title_zh: 公共厕所去哪儿了？
items.summary_en: An exploration of public bathroom availability and policy, examining how urban design and funding affect access and dignity in public spaces.
items.summary_zh: 探讨公共厕所的可用性与政策，分析城市设计和资金如何影响公众空间的可及性与尊严。

items.title_en: Jabber/XMPP: 25 Years of Digital Independence
items.title_zh: Jabber/XMPP：数字独立性 25 年
items.summary_en: Jabber/XMPP marks 25 years as an open, federated messaging system, continuing to offer interoperable, privacy-conscious communication. The piece reflects on its resilience amid walled-garden platforms and highlights ongoing relevance for organizations and users who value openness. It also discusses current challenges and future directions for federated messaging.
items.summary_zh: Jabber/XMPP 已作为开放、去中心化的消息系统走过 25 年，继续提供互通性与隐私友好的通信。从封闭平台的竞争中，它的去中心化特性仍具价值，并对强调开放性的组织与个人保持重要性。文章还讨论了当前挑战与未来走向。

items.title_en: Executable Is a SQLite Database
items.title_zh: 可执行文件就是一个 SQLite 数据库
items.summary_en: Treating an executable as a SQLite database reframes how we analyze and store binary code, enabling structured querying and tooling. The perspective suggests new ways to inspect, modify, or reason about binaries without abandoning traditional formats.
items.summary_zh: 把可执行程序当作 SQLite 数据库来看待，能以结构化的方式对二进制代码进行分析、查询和工具化操作。这一视角可能带来新的二进制分析方法，促进对现有格式的补充性思考。

items.title_en: Bookshelf – Self-hosted eBook library that runs on object storage
items.title_zh: Bookshelf——在对象存储上运行的自托管电子书库
items.summary_en: Bookshelf is a self-hosted eBook library that runs on object storage, enabling you to store and serve a large collection with minimal server overhead. The project highlights a barrier-free path to private digital libraries, leveraging S3-compatible storage and modern web UI. It matters for personal data sovereignty and offline access to books.
items.summary_zh: Bookshelf 是一个在对象存储上运行的自托管电子书库，可以用最小的服务器开销存储并分发大量书籍。该项目利用兼容 S3 的存储和现代网页界面，提供了搭建私人数字图书馆的简便路径。对个人数据自治和离线阅读具有现实意义。

items.title_en: LLMs could control their host machines by exploiting inference engines
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型可能利用推理引擎控制宿主机
items.summary_en: Security-minded piece outlining how LLMs might manipulate their execution environments by abusing inference engines, highlighting potential attack paths in ML-enabled stacks and the need for strict sandboxing, IO controls, and robust monitoring.
items.summary_zh: 安全导向的分析指出，LLMs 可能通过滥用推理引擎来控制宿主机器，揭示在机器学习栈中潜在的攻击路径，强调加强沙箱、输入输出限制与监控的必要性。

items.title_en: Anthropic's best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive
items.title_zh: Anthropic 的最佳 AI 模型在吸引用户方面遇冷，便宜工具更受欢迎
items.summary_en: Reports that Anthropic's top AI model is failing to attract users as cheaper competitors gain traction, raising questions about pricing, UX, and use-case fit. The piece suggests that access cost and ease of integration matter as much as raw capability for adoption.
items.summary_zh: 报道显示Anthropic 的顶尖 AI 模型在市场上难以吸引用户，便宜的竞争对手更具吸引力。这提出定价、用户体验和用例匹配等因素与能力同等重要的结论。

items.title_en: Octopus intelligence may be related to never-before-seen mutation
items.title_zh: 章鱼智力或与前所未见的突变有关
items.summary_en: New research ties heightened octopus cognition to an unseen genetic mutation that influences protein-building, offering clues about how cephalopods evolved such sophisticated behaviors. The finding adds a twist to the story of intelligence in the natural world.
items.summary_zh: 最新研究将章鱼智力提升与一种前所未见的基因突变联系起来，该突变可能影响蛋白质合成，揭示头足类认知进化的新线索。这一发现为自然界的智能演化增添新篇章。

items.title_en: Anna's Archive Owes $340 Million, Lost Several Domains, but It's Still Online
items.title_zh: Anna's Archive 欠款 3.4 亿美元，域名损失但仍在线
items.summary_en: Anna's Archive owes $340 million and has lost several domains, yet remains online, illustrating resilience of distributed archives amid legal and financial pressure. The case underscores the volatility of archival aggregators.
items.summary_zh: Anna's Archive 欠款 3.4 亿美元并丢失若干域名，但仍在线，显示在法律与财政压力下分布式档案的韧性与脆弱性。此事凸显档案聚合平台的易变性。

items.title_en: Vintage Artificial Intelligence: Before It Got Awkward
items.title_zh: 怀旧人工智能：在它变得尴尬之前
items.summary_en: A retrospective look at the early AI era before the field grappled with contemporary anxieties and ethical debates.
items.summary_zh: 回顾人工智能发展的早期阶段，在现代担忧和伦理辩论出现之前。文章回顾了当年的乐观愿景和技术局限，帮助读者理解今天 AI 热潮的来龙去脉。

items.title_en: Show HN: A techno machine in one HTML file, with verifiable renders
items.title_zh: Show HN：单文件 HTML 实现的科技机器，渲染可验证
items.summary_en: A compact, single-file HTML app that renders outputs which can be independently verified. Demonstrates reproducible client-side rendering with minimal code footprint, appealing to engineers who value auditability and portability.
items.summary_zh: 一个极简的单文件 HTML 应用，输出结果可独立验证，演示了在极小代码量下实现的可复现客户端渲染，适合重视审计性与可移植性的工程师。

items.title_en: Anger, Anxiety and Agency
items.title_zh: 愤怒、焦虑与行动力
items.summary_en: An essay exploring how emotions like anger and anxiety intersect with personal agency in tech and open-source cultures. It argues that acknowledging emotional dynamics is essential to sustaining productive work and meaningful influence within organizations.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章讨论愤怒与焦虑等情绪如何影响科技工作中的个人能动性，强调在技术文化中正视情感动态对维持高效工作和发挥影响力的重要性。

items.title_en: I were 17, I'd learn how to build LLMs from scratch
items.title_zh: 如果我17岁，我会从零开始学习如何构建大语言模型
items.summary_en: Learning the fundamentals now pays off later. Hands-on practice building LLMs from scratch builds intuition about architectures, data, and training dynamics. The takeaway is to focus on practical experimentation rather than relying solely on prebuilt APIs.
items.summary_zh: 如果年轻时就动手学习并从零开始构建LLMs，能更好掌握原理和局限。文章强调要认真理解架构、数据与训练过程，而不仅仅依赖现成的API。如此能培养工程直觉与创新能力。

items.title_en: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64
items.title_zh: SeL4 在 AArch64 架构上的安全证明完成
items.summary_en: Full formal security proofs for the SeL4 microkernel are now complete on AArch64, delivering strong, provable isolation guarantees for modern 64-bit ARM systems. This milestone reduces the risk of security holes in safety-critical environments like aerospace and automotive where formal verification matters. The work builds confidence in deploying formally verified kernels in production.
items.summary_zh: AArch64 上的 SeL4 微内核已完成全面的安全证明，为现代 64 位 ARM 系统提供可证明的隔离保障。这一里程碑降低了在航空航天、汽车等对安全性要求高的场景中暴露漏洞的风险，提升了在生产环境中部署形式化验证内核的信心。

items.title_en: Peppermint oil reduces blood pressure by 8.48 mmHg in small study
items.title_zh: 薄荷油在小规模研究中可降低血压约 8.48 mmHg
items.summary_en: A small study found peppermint oil reduces blood pressure by about 8.48 mmHg, suggesting potential cardiovascular effects. The results are preliminary and require larger trials.
items.summary_zh: 小规模研究发现 薄荷油可将血压降低约 8.48 mmHg，暗示潜在的心血管作用。但研究规模小，需更大规模的试验来验证。

items.title_en: A Blackstone real estate company exposed SSN digits, DOBs, addresses and more
items.title_zh: Blackstone 旗下房地产公司暴露 SSN 等个人信息
items.summary_en: An exposure at a Blackstone real estate company leaked sensitive PII including SSNs, DOBs, and addresses. The breach underscores the data governance risks in large corporate portfolios and the consequences of third-party data sharing.
items.summary_zh: Blackstone 旗下某房地产公司发生数据暴露，泄露了包括社会安全号码、出生日期和地址在内的敏感个人信息。该事件凸显大型企业投资组合中的数据治理风险及第三方数据共享的后果。

items.title_en: How I find problems to solve as a staff engineer
items.title_zh: 我在担任资深工程师时如何发现待解决的问题
items.summary_en: Learn a practical framework for identifying high-leverage problems as a staff engineer by combining system signals, user pain points, and business impact. The piece emphasizes partnering with product and ops, triaging by impact and effort, and turning findings into scoped initiatives with measurable outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍在担任资深工程师时如何通过系统信号、用户痛点和业务影响来发现高杠杆的问题，提供实用框架。强调与产品和运维协作、按影响与投入进行优先级排序，并将发现转化为有明确可衡量目标的计划。

items.title_en: Show HN: PicoMQ – Durable Streams over HTTP, on object storage
items.title_zh: Show HN：PicoMQ——通过对象存储在 HTTP 上实现持久化流
items.summary_en: PicoMQ proposes durable streams over HTTP backed by object storage, offering a scalable approach to reliable event streams without specialized infrastructure. By leveraging standard HTTP and object stores, it aims to simplify deployment and resilience for distributed apps.
items.summary_zh: PicoMQ 提出在 HTTP 之上、以对象存储为支持的持久化流方案，为可扩展的事件流提供无需专用基础设施的解决途径。通过利用标准 HTTP 与对象存储，它旨在简化分布式应用的部署与容错能力。

items.title_en: Show HN: GlassBox – what the browser reveals, and how identifiable you are
items.title_zh: Show HN：GlassBox—浏览器揭示的内容与可识别性
items.summary_en: GlassBox analyzes browser behavior to reveal how identifiable you are online, mapping what the browser leaks about you. The project demonstrates real-world fingerprinting risks and helps developers understand attack surfaces. It reinforces the need for stronger anti-fingerprinting and privacy-preserving browser features.
items.summary_zh: GlassBox 通过分析浏览器行为，揭示浏览器会暴露给在线环境的可识别信息。该工具展示了指纹识别的现实风险，帮助开发者理解攻击面，并强调需要更强的反指纹与隐私保护的浏览器特性。

items.title_en: I built a low-latency AI companion that plays Skyrim with me
items.title_zh: 我做了一个能和我一起玩《上古卷轴》的低延迟AI伙伴
items.summary_en: A low-latency AI companion that plays Skyrim with me demonstrates real-time in-game AI copilots. Leveraging optimized inference and streaming, it keeps up with fast gameplay, enabling a more interactive single-player experience. This kind of tech hints at future AI partners that can co-create with players.
items.summary_zh: 一个低延迟的AI伴侣可以与玩家在《上古卷轴》中实时互动，对战斗和探索提供即时协助。通过优化推理和实时流传输实现高响应性，提升单人游戏的沉浸感。这种技术暗示未来AI伙伴可能与玩家共同创造游戏体验。

items.title_en: What Is a Harness?
items.title_zh: What Is a Harness？
items.summary_en: A harness is a framework for coordinating and running software tasks, experiments, or deployments.
items.summary_zh: Harness 是用于协调和运行软件任务、实验或部署的框架。

items.title_en: Hot Chips 2026: CUDA Targets RISC-V – By Chester Lam
items.title_zh: Hot Chips 2026：CUDA 面向 RISC-V 的目标
items.summary_en: Hot Chips 2026 coverage notes CUDA targeting RISC-V, suggesting Nvidia may extend its toolchain or optimize performance for RISC-V cores. This could reshape software portability and ecosystem strategy for accelerators moving beyond x86/Aarch64. The move could influence how developers write GPU-accelerated apps.
items.summary_zh: Hot Chips 2026 的报道提到 CUDA 可能面向 RISC-V 架构，暗示英伟达将扩展工具链或为 RISC-V 核心优化性能。这可能改变对加速器的软件可移植性与生态策略，推动开发者在 GPU 加速应用上的新选择。

items.title_en: Removed all counters, replies, following/ers, timestamps, from textlog
items.title_zh: 从 textlog 移除了所有计数、回复、关注者和时间戳等元数据
items.summary_en: Textlog strips away social metrics like counters, replies, followers, and timestamps to rethink how readers engage with content and to reduce signal noise.
items.summary_zh: Textlog 移除了点赞、回复、关注者和时间戳等社交元数据，意在简化阅读体验并降低信息噪声。

items.title_en: Google Workspace thinks my domain is an email provider (2025)
items.title_zh: Google Workspace 把我的域名误判为邮件提供商
items.summary_en: Describes a misclassification by Google Workspace that labels a domain as an email provider, causing unexpected behavior in domain management and security settings.
items.summary_zh: 描述 Google Workspace 将某域名错误标注为电子邮件提供商，导致域名管理和安全设置方面出现异常。文中分析此错判对身份与托管配置的影响，以及对协作工作流的干扰。

items.title_en: New EU-wide product repair rules come into force
items.title_zh: 欧盟范围的新产品维修规则已生效
items.summary_en: New EU repair rules take effect, aiming to improve product longevity and reduce waste across the bloc. Expect requirements around spare parts availability, repair information, and consumer rights that empower independent repair shops and users.
items.summary_zh: 覆盖欧盟的新维修规则开始生效，旨在提升产品寿命、降低电子垃圾。规则将要求提供易得的备件、可获取的修理信息，并加强消费者对维修的权利，推动独立维修市场。

items.title_en: FDA clears blood test to aid evaluation for Alzheimer's disease
items.title_zh: FDA批准用于阿尔茨海默病评估的血液检测
items.summary_en: Regulators have cleared a blood biomarker test that assists clinicians evaluating suspected Alzheimer's disease. The test serves as an accessible, noninvasive adjunct to existing assessments, helping to stratify patients for further workup. It is not a standalone diagnostic tool, but it can streamline referrals and decision-making.
items.summary_zh: 监管机构已批准一种用于辅助评估疑似阿尔茨海默病的血液生物标志物检测，提供更便捷的辅助手段。该检测并非单独诊断工具，但可帮助医生在初筛阶段排序、加速转诊与后续治疗计划。

items.title_en: My agent.md to improve LLM-assisted code quality
items.title_zh: 我的 agent.md：提升 LLM 助力代码质量
items.summary_en: Proposes a structured 'agent.md' approach to guide LLM-assisted coding, using clear prompts, tool integration, and verification steps to raise code quality. It discusses building an autonomous agent that can plan, execute edits, and audit results, plus safety and reliability checks.
items.summary_zh: 提出将 agent.md 作为框架来组织 LLM 辅助编码，利用清晰的提示、工具集成和审核步骤提升代码质量。讨论构建具备计划、执行修改与结果审计能力的代理，以及安全与可靠性方面的考量。

items.title_en: A website for debloated open source alternatives
items.title_zh: 去臃肿的开源替代品网站
items.summary_en: Debloat.dev curates lighter, less feature-heavy open-source replacements for popular apps, aiming to reduce resource usage without sacrificing utility. The site helps users bypass bloatware and regain control over performance, privacy, and autonomy. For power users and older devices, it can be a practical shortcut to leaner software choices.
items.summary_zh: Debloat.dev 汇集了主流应用的更轻量、功能负担较低的开源替代品，目标是减少资源占用同时保留实用性。该站点帮助用户规避臃肿软件，提升性能、隐私与自主性。对于追求高效的高级用户和老旧设备，这是一条实用的替代路径。

items.title_en: Fast drilldown dashboards from a single Parquet file
items.title_zh: 用单个 Parquet 文件实现快速钻取式仪表盘
items.summary_en: A single Parquet file is used to drive fast, interactive dashboards with immediate drill-downs, avoiding heavy ETL pipelines. This approach can speed up analytics prototyping and reduce data prep friction for data teams; it also reveals tradeoffs around data freshness and schema evolution.
items.summary_zh: 通过单个 Parquet 文件驱动快速、交互式仪表板，实现即时钻取查询，省去了繁重的 ETL 过程。这种方法有助于加速分析原型开发，降低数据准备的门槛，但也需权衡数据新鲜度与模式演化带来的挑战。

items.title_en: Fences, Not Sandboxes
items.title_zh: 界限，而非沙箱
items.summary_en: Argues for architectural fences—clear boundary mechanisms and provenance controls—rather than heavy sandboxing to isolate processes. This approach aims to balance security, performance, and developer productivity.
items.summary_zh: 主张以明确的边界护栏取代重度沙箱，用更合适的边界与 provenance 控制来实现进程隔离，兼顾安全性、性能与开发效率。

items.title_en: What Is a Syslog Server?
items.title_zh: Syslog 服务器是什么？
items.summary_en: Syslog servers aggregate and centralize logs from network devices, applying simple, scalable logging pipelines to monitor, triage, and troubleshoot systems across environments.
items.summary_zh: Syslog 服务器用于集中收集来自网络设备的日志，提供可扩展的日志处理管道，帮助监控、分辨故障并排查系统问题。

items.title_en: Ox-Alpha Is GLM?
items.title_zh: Ox-Alpha 就是 GLM 吗？
items.summary_en: Ox-Alpha Is GLM? This explores whether Ox-Alpha is essentially GLM, prompting questions about its purpose and interoperability.
items.summary_zh: 质疑 Ox-Alpha 是否本质上等同于 GLM，以及这对其设计目标与互操作性的影响。

items.title_en: What's new in Emacs 31.1
items.title_zh: Emacs 31.1 有哪些新特性？
items.summary_en: Emacs 31.1 ships with a slate of incremental enhancements across editing, performance, and customization. Notable changes include improved package management, UI tweaks, and more reliable Lisp tooling, making daily use smoother for power users. The update reinforces Emacs’ longevity by continuing to evolve core capabilities with a familiar feel.
items.summary_zh: Emacs 31.1 带来一系列编辑、性能和定制方面的渐进改进。值得关注的变化包括改进的包管理、界面优化以及更可靠的 Lisp 工具链，使日常使用对高级用户更顺畅。此次更新延续了 Emacs 的长期演进，保持熟悉的使用体验同时提升核心能力。

items.title_en: Characterizing Agentic Flooding of Government Services
items.title_zh: 政府服务中的代理性涌入现象及其特征分析
items.summary_en: Characterizing Agentic Flooding of Government Services analyzes how autonomous agents or automated systems flood public services with requests, outlining risk factors and potential mitigations. The work informs policy on concurrency, throttling, and verification in AI-enabled public-sector tooling.
items.summary_zh: 对政府服务中的代理性涌入进行特征分析，评估自动化系统对公共服务的请求洪峰及其风险，并提出缓解策略。为 AI 驱动的公共部门工具在并发、流控与验证方面的政策提供参考。

items.title_en: How Complex Systems Fail (1998)
items.title_zh: 复杂系统如何失效（1998）
items.summary_en: The paper exposes how complex socio-technical systems fail through hidden interactions and cascading errors, not just individual faults. It argues for redesigns that emphasize safety culture, simple explanations for failures, and robust risk management—lessons that still apply to modern software and infrastructure. Understanding these dynamics helps teams anticipate cascades and improve resilience.
items.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了复杂社会技术系统如何通过隐藏的相互作用和级联错误而失败，而非仅仅是个别故障。它主张在设计上强调安全文化、对故障的简单解释以及强健的风险管理——这些教训至今仍适用于现代软件和基础设施。理解这些动力学有助于团队预测级联效应并提升韧性。

items.title_en: Woman stranded in Spain after UK's eVisa system mistakes her for twin sister
items.title_zh: 英国电子签证系统误把她当成双胞姐妹，女子滞留西班牙
items.summary_en: A real-world case where identity error in e-visa processing stranded a traveler abroad, highlighting flaws in automated identity checks and cross-border verification. It underscores the human impact of digital-government friction and the need for robust identity management.
items.summary_zh: 一起因电子签证身份识别错误导致旅行者在国外滞留的真实事件，揭示了自动身份核验和跨境核验中的缺陷。凸显数字政府流程中的人类成本，以及对更健全身份管理的需求。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Why do corporate failures always seem to punish the wrong people?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：为什么企业失败似乎总惩罚错了人？
items.summary_en: A discussion about accountability and misaligned incentives in corporate failures, exploring who bears the cost of mistakes—leadership, managers, or frontline workers—and how structures affect blame and recovery.
items.summary_zh: 讨论企业失败中的问责与激励错位，探讨错误成本由谁承担——领导、管理者还是一线员工——以及组织结构如何影响惩罚与恢复。

items.title_en: Over 170k Nonprofits Lost All Their Data. Is Microsoft to Blame?
items.title_zh: 超过17万家非营利组织丢失全部数据：微软该负责吗？
items.summary_en: Reports a large-scale data loss affecting more than 170k nonprofits, raising questions about data retention policies and risk management for cloud services. The piece analyzes responsibility, data portability, and the need for better backups and vendor accountability.
items.summary_zh: 报道超过十七万家非营利组织遭遇数据全部丢失，引发对云端服务的数据保留策略和风险管理的质疑。文章分析责任归属、数据可携带性，以及提升备份与供应商问责制的需求。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kern – container and resource runtime in a 1.5 MB binary, no daemon
items.title_zh: Kern：1.5MB 二进制的容器与资源运行时，无需守护进程
items.summary_en: Kern presents a minimal container and resource runtime packaged as a 1.5 MB binary with no daemon, enabling lightweight isolation on edge or offline devices without the baggage of a full daemon-based runtime.
items.summary_zh: Kern 提供一个仅 1.5MB 二进制的极简容器与资源运行时，无需守护进程，便于边缘设备或离线场景的轻量级隔离与运行。

items.title_en: The treasury bond mess: is this the demise of the US as a safe haven?
items.title_zh: 国债乱象：美国作为避险资产的地位会否走向终结？
items.summary_en: Discusses turmoil around U.S. Treasury markets amid debt politics and policy uncertainty; raises questions about the US as a global safe haven and potential shifts in capital flows and yields.
items.summary_zh: 讨论在债务政治与政策不确定性背景下美债市场的动荡，提出美国作为全球避险资产地位是否会发生变化，以及潜在的资金流向与收益率格局调整。

items.title_en: Walgit – a Git server that is one binary in front of an object store
items.title_zh: Walgit：在对象存储前端的一体化 Git 服务器
items.summary_en: Walgit presents a Git server architecture where a single binary fronts an object store, simplifying deployment and potentially improving performance and scalability.
items.summary_zh: Walgit 提出一种在对象存储前端的单一二进制 Git 服务器架构，简化部署并有望提升性能与可扩展性。

items.title_en: To become a better writer, read as much as you can
items.title_zh: 多读书，写作更好
items.summary_en: Advocates reading widely as the fastest path to improve writing, emphasizing deliberate reading, note-taking, and analyzing style. The piece offers practical steps to turn reading into better sentence craft and ideas.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张通过广泛阅读来提升写作能力，强调有目的的阅读、做笔记和分析风格的重要性，并给出将阅读转化为写作技巧的实用步骤。

items.title_en: Show HN: How to mentally calculate the day of the week for any date
items.title_zh: Show HN：如何用心算计算任意日期的周几
items.summary_en: Show HN: A concise method to mentally compute the weekday for any date, with steps you can memorize and apply quickly.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：一套简明的心算方法，能快速计算任意日期的周几，附带可记忆的步骤与示例。

items.title_en: I gave Qwen 3.8 27B a reverse-engineering job and it finished in 30 minutes
items.title_zh: 我给 Qwen 3.8 27B 指派做反向工程任务，30 分钟就完成
items.summary_en: Hands-on test shows a 27B LLM can perform a reverse-engineering task quickly, highlighting AI assistance for code analysis and problem solving. It demonstrates potential speedups in tasks like malware analysis or binary comprehension, while reminding that verification and safety checks remain essential.
items.summary_zh: 亲身测试显示 Qwen 3.8 27B 能在短时间内完成反向工程任务，展现了 AI 对代码分析与问题求解的辅助潜力。虽然可能带来分析效率的提升，但仍需谨慎验证并注意安全与准确性。

items.title_en: OCR It – pull text out of un-copyable documents for your LLM
items.title_zh: OCR It：从不可复制的文档中提取文本供LLM使用
items.summary_en: OCR It is an open-source tool that extracts text from documents that resist copying, feeding the results into LLM workflows. It supports scanned images and PDFs to unlock content for AI prompts and data processing. The project lowers the barrier to using non-editable sources in AI-enabled pipelines.
items.summary_zh: OCR It 是一个开源工具，能够从难以复制的文档中提取文本，并将结果用于LLM工作流。它支持对扫描图像和不可编辑的PDF进行OCR处理，解锁内容供AI输入和数据处理。该项目降低了在AI工作流中使用受限文本的门槛。

items.title_en: Agent Lightning v1.0
items.title_zh: Agent Lightning v1.0 发布
items.summary_en: Agent Lightning v1.0 marks the initial release of a lightweight AI-agent framework designed for building modular, pluggable agents. It focuses on simplicity and rapid experimentation, enabling developers to compose skills and integrations with clear interfaces. The release signals an accessible entry point for teams prototyping autonomous workflows.
items.summary_zh: Agent Lightning v1.0 作为轻量级 AI 代理框架的初次发布，目标是让构建可模块化的代理更简单。它强调简易性和快速试验，开发者可以用清晰的接口组合技能和集成。此发布为团队原型化自治工作流提供了更易入门的入口。

items.title_en: Why older tech is sometimes safer from hackers
items.title_zh: 为何更旧的技术在某些情况下更不易被黑客攻击
items.summary_en: Older tech often avoids the sprawling attack surface of modern platforms, and its slower update cycle reduces exposure to newly discovered vulnerabilities. However, aging software and patch gaps introduce separate risks.
items.summary_zh: 旧技术往往避免现代平台庞大的攻击面，更新周期较慢也降低了对新发现漏洞的暴露。然而，过时的软件与补丁缺口也带来独立风险。文章点出在某些情境下，旧技术在实践中可能更安全。

items.title_en: Codefloe Is a Professionally Hosted Public Git Forge
items.title_zh: Codefloe：专业托管的公开 Git Forge
items.summary_en: Codefloe offers a professionally hosted public Git forge, aiming to deliver enterprise-grade hosting for open-source repos. It emphasizes reliability, security, and governance features to attract teams.
items.summary_zh: Codefloe 提供专业托管的公开 Git Forge，面向开源仓库提供企业级托管。强调可靠性、安全性与治理等特性，旨在吸引团队使用。

items.title_en: My favorite nonfiction books about cults, scams, and schemes
items.title_zh: 我最喜欢的关于邪教、骗局和阴谋的非虚构书籍
items.summary_en: Curated nonfiction works about cults, scams, and schemes, offering deep dives into manipulation, social psychology, and fraud. The selections help readers recognize misinformation, understand how scams unfold, and improve critical thinking for evaluating tech hype and online narratives.
items.summary_zh: 精选关于邪教、骗局与阴谋的非虚构著作，深入探讨操控、社会心理与欺诈机制。帮助读者提升识别错误信息的能力，理解骗局如何运作，并在评估科技领域的热点话题和网络叙事时保持清醒判断。

items.title_en: Over 5,200 Ebola cases recorded in Congo
items.title_zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情累计确诊超5200例
items.summary_en: WHO reports over 5,200 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo within 100 days of outbreak declaration, underscoring ongoing public health challenges, vaccine deployment, and surveillance needs.
items.summary_zh: 世界卫生组织报告，在爆发宣布后的100天内，刚果民主共和国已记录超过5200例埃博拉病例，凸显持续的公共卫生挑战、疫苗部署与监测需求。

items.title_en: Malware infects Android-based automotive head unit firmware
items.title_zh: Android 汽车中控固件被木马感染
items.summary_en: Malware has compromised an Android-based automotive head unit, showing that infotainment firmware can be a doorway into a car's ecosystem. The attack likely leverages insecure update pathways or compromised apps, enabling persistence and potential control of connected features. This case underscores the need for stronger supply-chain security, code signing, and robust OTA verification in modern vehicles.
items.summary_zh: 研究发现基于 Android 的汽车中控固件被木马入侵，显现信息娱乐系统也可能成为进入车载生态的入口。攻击链可能利用不安全的更新机制或被篡改的应用，从而实现持久化和对连接功能的潜在控制。这凸显了在现代汽车中加强供应链安全、代码签名和鲁棒 OTA 验证的重要性。

items.title_en: Fable and the end of the free lunch
items.title_zh: Fable 与免费午餐时代的终结
items.summary_en: Argues that the era of 'free lunch'—easy, cheap AI progress—may be ending as hardware, data, and energy costs scale with model improvements. It weighs bottlenecks and suggests a shift toward more efficient architectures, smarter training, and software optimization to keep AI advancing affordably.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，依赖简单、廉价的 AI 进步的“免费午餐”时代似乎结束，硬件、数据与能耗成本在模型规模扩张中上升。文中讨论了瓶颈，并提出更高效的架构、更聪明的训练以及软件优化以维持经济可行的AI发展。

items.title_en: Wi-Fi 8 is the first wireless upgrade in years that isn't chasing speed
items.title_zh: Wi-Fi 8：多年升级不再全力追求速度
items.summary_en: Wi-Fi 8 shifts priorities from raw speed toward reliability, coverage, energy efficiency, and security features amid rising smart home needs.
items.summary_zh: Wi‑Fi 8 将优先关注可靠性、覆盖、能效与安全性等特性，而非追逐更高速度，适应物联网家庭需求。

items.title_en: Could we dredge the Netherlands without fossil fuels? (2018)
items.title_zh: 在没有化石燃料的情况下，我们能否用新能源来挖荷兰运河？（2018）
items.summary_en: It highlights practical limits and creative solutions for decarbonizing heavy civil work.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨是否能用可再生能源来驱动荷兰的挖掘作业，评估风能、太阳能、储能与效率提升等是否足以取代化石燃料。并指出在实现大型土木任务低碳化方面的现实限制与创新思路。

items.title_en: The Future Belongs to the Weird
items.title_zh: 未来属于怪诞者
items.summary_en: Argues that breakthroughs often come from unconventional, counterintuitive ideas rather than mainstream trends. Embracing the weird can unlock novel interfaces, products, and business models that conventional thinkers overlook.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张突破性进展往往来自非常规、反直觉的点子，而非主流趋势。拥抱怪诞思维可能解锁新颖界面、产品与商业模式，是常规思维所忽略的机会。

items.title_en: Hot Chips 2026: Applying High Bandwidth Flash (HBF)
items.title_zh: Hot Chips 2026：高带宽闪存（HBF）的应用
items.summary_en: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) concepts are being applied to push higher throughput into storage systems, addressing AI/ML and data-center workloads.
items.summary_zh: 高带宽闪存（HBF）的应用正在推动存储系统实现更高的吞吐，满足 AI/ML 与数据中心工作负载。文章讨论对未来 SSD 的延迟、带宽与内存层次结构的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Crafting QR Codes: A deep dive into QR code art (2024)
items.title_zh: 打造二维码：2024 年的二维码艺术深度研究
items.summary_en: Crafting QR Codes dives into the art and science of QR code design in 2024, exploring how to balance aesthetics with scan reliability.
items.summary_zh: 本文深入探讨 2024 年 QR 码设计的艺术与科学，研究在美感与可扫性之间的取舍与技巧。内容涵盖纠错、掩码与风格化解码等，使二维码在美观与可用性之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: Why Sal Khan't: On Learning by Making but Teaching by Telling
items.title_zh: 萨尔·汗为何：学习要通过动手实践，但教学却偏向讲授
items.summary_en: The piece argues for learning-by-doing and constructing knowledge through making, not just being told. It critiques over-reliance on lectures and advocates balancing exploration with explicit explanation to improve retention and transfer. The takeaway is that education benefits from hands-on practice paired with thoughtful guidance.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张通过动手实践来学习、通过做中建构知识，而不仅仅是被告知。它批评对讲授的过度依赖，提倡将探索与清晰讲解相结合，以提升记忆与迁移能力。核心观点是教育应在动手练习与引导性讲解之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: Explain it to me like I'm ten
items.title_zh: 像对十岁儿童解释一样
items.summary_en: Tim Harford argues for explaining complex topics in plain language, using simple analogies and step-by-step reasoning to make ideas accessible without losing accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 蒂姆·哈福德主张用通俗语言解释复杂概念，借助简单的类比和分步推理，使观点更易理解且不失准确性。该文强调这种表达方式有助于提升公众理解力，帮助人们做出更明智的决定。

items.title_en: Agent Is Not the Model
items.title_zh: 代理不是模型
items.summary_en: Describes a distinction between an AI agent and the underlying model, arguing systems should treat them as separate concerns. Emphasizes governance, testing, and evaluation frameworks that account for agent behavior rather than relying on model quality alone.
items.summary_zh: 阐明 AI 代理与底层模型之间的区别，主张将二者分离处理。强调治理、测试与评估框架，应关注代理行为而不仅仅是模型质量。

items.title_en: Coconut oil jet fuel matches kerosene's efficiency in engine tests
items.title_zh: 椰子油喷气燃料在发动机测试中与煤油效率相当
items.summary_en: Tests show coconut-oil-based jet fuel delivering comparable efficiency to kerosene in engines, signaling a potential sustainable alternative for aviation fuel. However, questions remain about scalability, supply chains, and lifecycle emissions. If scalable, natural-feedstock fuels could diversify aviation fuel options.
items.summary_zh: 发动机测试显示以椰子油为基础的喷气燃料在效率上与煤油相当，提示其可能成为航空燃料的可持续替代方案。但关于规模化、供应链和全生命周期排放等仍有待解决；若可规模化，天然原料燃料能为航空燃料选项带来更多样性。

items.title_en: Nearly 3M Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
items.title_zh: 约300万辆特斯拉在中国因隐藏门把手被召回
items.summary_en: Nearly 3 million Teslas in China are recalled over door handles that can remain hidden and fail to operate, raising safety concerns and attracting regulatory attention. The scale underscores the challenges of EV fleets in a major market and the ongoing quality scrutiny for automakers.
items.summary_zh: 在中国，近300万辆特斯拉因隐藏门把手问题被召回，存在安全隐患并引发监管关注。大规模召回凸显了在全球最大市场之一推动电动汽车的质控与合规挑战。

items.title_en: The Vibe Tax
items.title_zh: 氛围税
items.summary_en: Argues that intangible 'vibe' costs—time and cognitive load spent maintaining appearances—are a real, overlooked tax on productivity and well-being. It suggests strategies to reduce unnecessary social signaling and focus on substantive work.
items.summary_zh: 作者指出维持‘氛围’所带来的无形成本其实是一种隐性税，影响生产力和身心健康。提出减少不必要的社交信号、聚焦实质工作的应对之道。

items.title_en: Anthropic Claude and API service outages
items.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 与 API 服务中断
items.summary_en: Outages affecting Claude API users, with status updates illustrating reliability concerns; highlights importance of service resilience and multi-region deploys for critical AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: Claude API 使用受阻，状态更新反映了可靠性担忧；凸显对高可靠性、跨区域部署以支撑关键 AI 工作负载的需求。

items.title_en: The Sloppification of Peptides
items.title_zh: 肽研究的草率化趋势
items.summary_en: A critical look at how sloppy practices in peptide science are affecting reproducibility and reliability, from synthesis errors to data reporting. The piece advocates for stricter standards, better documentation, and reproducible workflows in peptide research.
items.summary_zh: 从肽合成错误到数据报告不规范，批评肽领域的草率化做法如何损害可重复性与可靠性。倡导更严格的标准、完整的记录以及可重复的工作流程。

items.title_en: Implementation of GPT-2 in pure CMake
items.title_zh: 在纯 CMake 中实现 GPT‑2
items.summary_en: A compact, educational project that implements a GPT-2 model within a CMake-centric workflow. It demonstrates that build systems can host ML code and prompts readers to rethink where ML logic belongs—inside a build script or a runtime library.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个紧凑且具教育意义的项目，在以 CMake 为核心的工作流中实现了 GPT-2 模型。它展示了构建系统也能承载 ML 代码，并促使读者重新思考 ML 逻辑应放在构建脚本内还是运行时库中。

items.title_en: Why is Anthropic's public writing style so unlike Claude's?
items.title_zh: 为何 Anthropic 的公开写作风格与 Claude 的不同？
items.summary_en: Analyzes differences between corporate communication style and the model's branding; discusses how Anthropic's public-writing choices shape user trust, transparency, and alignment messaging.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Anthropic 的公开写作风格为何与旗下 Claude 模型的表达不同，讨论这类沟通选择如何影响用户信任、透明度与对齐信息的传达。

items.title_en: JIT Compiling Code in 5μs
items.title_zh: 5微秒内实现JIT编译的代码
items.summary_en: An exploration of techniques that push Just-In-Time compilation into the microsecond range, challenging latency assumptions for dynamic languages. The piece weighs the trade-offs between compilation speed and code quality, with implications for interactive apps and language runtimes.
items.summary_zh: 介绍将 JIT 编译推向微秒级别的技术路径，挑战动态语言对延迟的传统认知。讨论编译速度与代码质量之间的权衡，以及对交互式应用和语言运行时的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Rural Village in Spain Is Welcoming Digital Nomads with Open Arms
items.title_zh: 西班牙乡村热情欢迎数字游民
items.summary_en: Profiles a Spanish rural village actively courting digital nomads to spur local economy and cultural exchange. The story highlights affordable living, growing remote-work amenities, and community integration that make longer stays feasible.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个西班牙农村村庄积极招募数字游民以促进地方经济和文化交流。报道强调低生活成本、日益完善的远程工作设施，以及有利于长期居留的社区融入。

items.title_en: The planet now has more trees than it did 35 years ago (2018)
items.title_zh: 地球现在的树木数量比35年前多
items.summary_en: Reports a study showing the planet has more trees now than 35 years ago, driven by reforestation and natural regrowth in some regions. It discusses measurement challenges, regional shifts, and what this implies for climate mitigation and biodiversity.
items.summary_zh: 报道一项研究表明，全球树木覆盖量在35年来有所增加，部分地区的再造林和自然再生贡献显著。文中分析测量不确定性、区域差异，并探讨对气候缓解与生物多样性的影响。

items.title_en: Migrating a Synology NAS to a UniFi UNAS Pro 8 with Robocopy, SMB Multichannel
items.title_zh: 用 Robocopy 与 SMB Multichannel 将 Synology NAS 迁移到 UniFi UNAS Pro 8
items.summary_en: Migration from a Synology NAS to a UniFi UNAS Pro 8 using Robocopy and SMB Multichannel, with tips on avoiding common pitfalls. It highlights how network configuration and SMB settings can dramatically impact transfer speed and reliability. The takeaway is that small misconfigurations can cost real throughput during migrations.
items.summary_zh: 介绍使用 Robocopy 和 SMB Multichannel 将 Synology NAS 迁移到 UniFi UNAS Pro 8，并给出避免常见坑点的建议。强调网络配置与 SMB 设置对传输速度和稳定性的影响可观。核心要点在于微小的配置错误会显著影响迁移吞吐量。

items.title_en: Mourning Steve French
items.title_zh: 悼念 Steve French
items.summary_en: Obituary honoring Steve French for his contributions to the Linux/open-source community, particularly in storage-related areas. Reflects on his lasting impact and the sense of community within open-source development.
items.summary_zh: 纪念 Steve French，肯定他在 Linux 开源社区，尤其是存储领域的贡献。回顾他对开源社区的持久影响，以及社区协作在技术进步中的作用。

items.title_en: Death to px, long live ch
items.title_zh: 告别 px，迎来 CH 的排版新常态
items.summary_en: Advocates replacing pixel-based measurements with CSS 'ch' units to create more robust, scalable typography and layouts. The piece argues this choice improves accessibility and responsiveness, and outlines practical migration tips for developers updating existing styles.
items.summary_zh: 倡导用 CSS 的“ch”单位取代像素（px）来实现更稳健、可伸缩的排版与布局，提升无障碍和响应性。给出实际迁移建议，帮助开发者将现有样式迁移到以字体宽度为基础的单位。

items.title_en: Training AI to Paint with Code
items.title_zh: 用代码训练 AI 进行绘画
items.summary_en: Describes training AI to generate art driven by code prompts, blurring the line between programming and painting.
items.summary_zh: 讲述通过代码提示训练 AI 进行绘画，将编程与艺术创作的边界拉近。内容强调以代码为驱动的提示如何更精准地控制艺术输出，以及对模型训练的新视角。

items.title_en: I dream of quieter computing
items.title_zh: 我梦想着更安静的计算
items.summary_en: The essay surveys how hardware noise—from fans to hard drives—disrupts the workspace and argues for quieter computing designs. It explores practical steps like quieter cooling, fan curve tuning, and considering passive cooling or sound-dampening setups.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了计算硬件的噪声如何影响工作环境，并提出更安静的计算设计思路。讨论了降低噪声的具体做法，如安静散热、风扇调速和被动冷却等。

items.title_en: Kodak DC50 now usable on the Apple II
items.title_zh: Kodak DC50 现已可在 Apple II 上使用
items.summary_en: Describes a project to get the Kodak DC50 digital camera usable on an Apple II, outlining the hardware and software glue required to bridge vintage IO with modern imaging.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个项目，使得 Kodak DC50 数码相机能够在 Apple II 上工作，概述完成桥接老式硬件与现代成像所需的硬件与软件方法。

items.title_en: AI and Infrastructure Engineering
items.title_zh: AI 与基础设施工程
items.summary_en: Explores how AI is changing infrastructure engineering by enabling smarter design, diagnostics, and automation for networks, power grids, and data centers. It discusses challenges such as data quality, model reliability, and integration with existing tools.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 如何改变基础设施工程领域，实现更智能的设计、诊断与自动化，覆盖网络、能源系统和数据中心等场景。讨论数据质量、模型可靠性以及与现有工具集成等挑战。

items.title_en: AI Chip Architectures
items.title_zh: AI 芯片架构
items.summary_en: A survey of AI chip architectures and how architectural choices—like memory hierarchy, dataflow, and sparsity—shape model performance and efficiency. The post ties current AI workloads to hardware design trends and hints at future directions.
items.summary_zh: 概述 AI 芯片架构，以及内存层级、数据流和稀疏性等设计选择如何影响模型性能与能效。文中将当前 AI 工作负载与硬件设计趋势联系起来，并指向未来的研究方向。

items.title_en: Amiga-Inspired AROS Goes Bare Metal on Raspberry Pi
items.title_zh: 受 Amiga 启发的 AROS 在树莓派上实现裸机运行
items.summary_en: AROS, an Amiga-inspired OS, runs bare-metal on Raspberry Pi, demonstrating retro OS experiments that sidestep a traditional host OS. The project showcases how open-source, lightweight systems can leverage modern hardware for hobbyist or educational purposes.
items.summary_zh: AROS 是一个受 Amiga 启发的操作系统，在树莓派上实现裸机运行，展示了跳过传统宿主操作系统的复古系统实验。该项目展示了开源、轻量级系统如何利用现代硬件用于爱好者或教育用途。

items.title_en: Parallel development without the headaches using Git worktree
items.title_zh: 使用 Git worktree 实现并行开发，摆脱头痛
items.summary_en: Shows how git worktree enables parallel development on multiple branches without bouncing between clones.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Git worktree 如何在多分支上实现并行开发，而无需频繁克隆切换。文中给出搭建要点、注意事项与工作流，减少上下文切换和合并的痛点。

items.title_en: The Remote Work Challenge: Lessons from 5 Cities
items.title_zh: 远程工作的挑战：来自五座城市的经验教训
items.summary_en: Summarizes lessons from five cities grappling with remote work, highlighting how local policies, infrastructure, and culture shape productivity, inclusion, and real estate costs. It provides practical takeaways for employers and urban planners on coordinating distributed teams.
items.summary_zh: 总结五座城市在远程工作方面的经验教训，强调地方政策、基础设施与文化如何影响生产力、包容性和房地产成本。为雇主和城市规划者提供分布式团队协同的实用建议。

items.title_en: Decoding silent reading from non-invasive EEG
items.title_zh: 通过非侵入性脑电解码无声阅读
items.summary_en: Shows that non-invasive EEG can reveal what a person is silently reading by decoding brain activity, advancing our understanding of internal cognition. The work points to possible future brain-computer interfaces and reading-tracking applications, while noting challenges in accuracy and privacy.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，非侵入性脑电图可以解码个体的无声阅读内容，通过脑信号推断正在阅读的文本。该研究推动对内部认知过程的理解，也为未来脑机接口和阅读监测应用提供思路，同时需关注准确性与隐私等挑战。

items.title_en: Things I want in a modern relational query language
items.title_zh: 我对现代关系查询语言的期待
items.summary_en: A post outlines desired features for the next generation of relational query languages, including richer expressions, stronger type-safety, better handling of semi-structured data, and improved integration with streaming and multi-model workloads.
items.summary_zh: 该文概述了对下一代关系查询语言的期望特性，包括更丰富的表达能力、更强的类型安全、对半结构化数据的更好处理，以及与流处理与多模型工作负载的更好集成。

items.title_en: Nostr is an inclusive communication commons
items.title_zh: Nostr：一个包容性的沟通公地
items.summary_en: Nostr aims to be a global, inclusive, censorship-resistant communication protocol built as a shared public resource rather than a single platform. Its emphasis on open participation and independent relays could shift how social apps are built and moderated, swapping centralized control for interoperable, user-owned infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Nostr 是一个全球化、包容性强且抗审查的沟通协议，旨在成为共享的公用资源而非单一平台。它对开放参与和独立中继的强调可能影响社交应用的构建与治理，将中心化控制让渡给可互操作、由用户掌握的基础设施。

items.title_en: I set a trap for a book-marketing scammer (2025)
items.title_zh: I set a trap for a book-marketing scammer (2025)
items.summary_en: I set a trap for a book-marketing scammer (2025) documents how the author turned the tables on a scammer targeting authors with fake marketing pitches. The piece exposes common scam tactics and offers practical tips for recognizing and avoiding shady book-marketing schemes.
items.summary_zh: 作者在《I set a trap for a book-marketing scammer (2025)》里讲述如何以反制手段对付以书籍营销为名的诈骗者。文中揭露了常用的诈骗手法，并给出识别与规避此类推销骗局的实用要点。
